## 主要学术背景 | Scholarly background

**中文。** 苏拉威西岩画研究已经连续改变“象征性图像何时出现”的时间尺度：过去十余年，岛上动物画和手印不断获得更新的铀系年代。穆纳岛的新结果进一步把可靠测年的手印传统推进到至少6.78万年前，并把岩画研究与现代人穿越华莱西亚、进入萨胡尔大陆的迁徙时间联系起来。由于岩画本身通常无法直接测年，覆盖其上的方解石测年方法和最小年代解释尤其关键。

**English.** Research on Sulawesi rock art has repeatedly pushed back the chronology of symbolic image-making as animal paintings and hand stencils have received increasingly early uranium-series ages. The Muna Island result extends a securely dated hand-stencil tradition to at least 67.8 ka and links rock-art chronology with the timing of modern-human dispersal through Wallacea toward Sahul. Because the pigment itself is usually not directly datable, the method of dating overlying calcite and interpreting a minimum age is central to the claim.

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 研究团队在穆纳岛Liang Metanduno洞穴一处手印岩画表面覆盖的方解石上使用激光烧蚀铀系测年，得到71.6±3.8 ka的方解石年龄，从而给岩画本身提供≥67.8 ka的最小年代。团队在苏拉威西东南部系统调查44处岩画地点，其中14处此前未记录。

**English.** Laser-ablation uranium-series dating of calcite overlying a hand stencil at Liang Metanduno yielded an age of 71.6 ± 3.8 ka, establishing a minimum age of 67.8 ka for the underlying image. The wider project documented 44 rock-art sites in Southeast Sulawesi, including 14 newly recorded localities.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 这不仅刷新可靠测年的岩画年代，更把象征性图像生产与现代人穿越华莱西亚、进入萨胡尔大陆的早期海上迁徙联系起来。它说明约6.8万年前苏拉威西已经存在成熟的手印岩画传统，并使“现代人何时具备稳定的象征表达与海洋适应能力”成为同一个考古问题的一部分。

**English.** The discovery matters beyond a record age. It links symbolic image-making with the early maritime dispersal of modern humans through Wallacea toward Sahul, showing that a developed hand-stencil tradition existed in Sulawesi by roughly 68,000 years ago. It therefore connects questions of cognition, symbolic practice, and maritime colonization.

## 学术出版物 | Academic publications

Oktaviana, A. A., Joannes-Boyau, R., Hakim, B., Burhan, B., Sardi, R., Adhityatama, S., Jalandoni, A., Hamrullah, Sumantri, I., Tang, M., Lebe, R., Iswadi, Ilyas, I., Abbas, A., Jusdi, A., Mahardian, D. E., Intan, F. S., Noerwidi, S., Ririmasse, M. N. R., et al. (2026). Rock art from at least 67,800 years ago in Sulawesi. Nature, 650(8102), 652–656. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09968-y

**开放获取状态 | Open-access status.** 开放获取，CC BY-NC-ND 4.0；原图仅按许可原样使用。 / Open access, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; figures are used unmodified under the licence.

**出版物内容（中文）。** 文章采用激光烧蚀铀系测年分析覆盖在穆纳岛手印岩画之上的方解石，得到岩画至少6.78万年的最小年代。研究把可靠测年的图像传统推进到现代人穿越华莱西亚并向萨胡尔扩散的早期阶段，使象征行为、海洋迁徙和区域文化连续性能够在同一时间框架中讨论。

**What the publication shows (English).** The study uses laser-ablation uranium-series dating of calcite overlying a hand stencil on Muna Island to establish a minimum age of 67.8 ka. It places a securely dated image-making tradition within the early modern-human dispersal through Wallacea toward Sahul, allowing symbolic behaviour, maritime movement and regional cultural continuity to be discussed within the same chronology.
